title: Pedestal Air Circulator
description: Almonard's air circulators are engineered to deliver powerful and efficient air circulation in industrial and commercial settings. Ideal for factories, warehouses and large commercial areas. Guaranteed for 1 year. 3-speed settings for precise airflow control, adjustable tilt for targeted air circulation, heavy-duty aluminium alloy blades, double ball-bearing motor for relentless cooling, closed mesh guard for safe operation, adjustable height, strong streamlined pedestal for greater stability.
